title: Quantum theory for phonon lasing and non-classical state generation in mixed-species and single trapped ions
summary: In this article we present a comprehensive theoretical investigation of phonon lasing with mixed-species trapped ions, as demonstrated in [T. Behrle, Phys. Rev. Lett. 131 (2023)], employing both a semi-classical mean-field description and a full quantum theory. We derive an analytic expression for the second-order coherence function, confirming the experimental observation of the system's lasing behaviour above threshold.
